role: propositional value of a ground quantifier-free formula under an atom valuation
notes: Each distinct ground atom is one propositional variable; same bracket glyph as the registered semantic brackets, here indexed by an atom valuation.

role: atom valuation induced by a structure or by a set of ground atoms
notes: v_N(A)=1 iff N satisfies A; v_B is the characteristic function of B.

role: Herbrand (dual-Skolem) form of a rectified prenex sentence
notes: Existential sentence in the expanded signature; universals replaced by new function terms of the preceding existential variables.

role: Herbrand-form matrix
notes: theta here is the quantifier-free matrix of a prenex sentence, following the inherited Skolemization definition; it is not a substitution in this scope.

role: expanded signature of the Herbrand form
notes: theta here is the quantifier-free matrix of a prenex sentence, following the inherited Skolemization definition; it is not a substitution in this scope.

role: new Herbrand function symbol
notes: theta here is the quantifier-free matrix of a prenex sentence, following the inherited Skolemization definition; it is not a substitution in this scope.

role: prenex dual of a prenex sentence (negation pushed through the prefix)
notes: Quantifiers exchanged and matrix negated; logically equivalent to the negation of sigma.

role: clause family of the negated Herbrand matrix
notes: Cl(nnf(neg theta^H)), read universally.

role: Statman's ambiguous equation: either a=b or b=a
notes: Statman 1977 p.902 notation, kept as printed.  Overlaps the registered unification-equation role of \(\doteq\) (Parts 2--12); the local role is declared in def:p02-w02-p02-028-st-K and is confined to this section.

role: Kreisel--Tait equation calculus and its substitution-only fragment
notes: Statman 1977 p.902; after p.904 K denotes the calculus without rules (3) and (4_n).

role: Statman's axiom set (1)--(6_n) for the structures with N and F
notes: Statman 1977 p.900.

role: n-fold successor
notes: s^1=s and s^{k+1}=ss^k (Statman 1977 p.900).

role: measure on terms and its transfer along a substitution
notes: Statman 1977 p.901; M^*(a)=M(theta a), or M(c(...,t/x_t,...)) in the flattening proof.

role: length: number of symbol occurrences in a term or equation occurrences in a computation
notes: Statman 1977 pp.901--902 uses lh for both; the argument type disambiguates.

role: Statman's simultaneous substitution notation
notes: Statman 1977 p.901; E(a/x) also marks the occurrences of x as the place of substitution in rule (1).

role: computations obtained from T by Statman's transformations
notes: Statman 1977 pp.903--908: rightmost and leftmost reduction forms; M-direct, subterm and weak-subterm forms.

role: stage data of the identification procedure
notes: Statman 1977 pp.904--905; distinct from the example set S_n of [2.15], whose scope is thm:p02-w02-p02-028-st-cycle.

role: implication from the conjunction of a finite equation set
notes: Statman 1977 p.904; analytic when valid with satisfiable antecedent.
